runtime.database: PGlite embedded PostgreSQL; one connection, no network

limits: Owned in-memory synthetic PostgreSQL data only; no hosted load test
Financial view cost is represented by posted ledger rows, not every production source-table join
Logical concurrent arrivals use one owned PostgreSQL connection and serialized whole snapshots; not a multi-client contention benchmark
Latency excludes HTTP, authentication, browser rendering and remote network; p95 targets are not production claims

correctness: All sites and holder cash states equal before/after, normalized decimal metadata types
